audit_items.proof_trace: verifyCodeChallenge rejects any method !== 'S256' (returns false immediately), then computes SHA256(verifier).base64url via Node.js crypto and compares with === to the stored challenge. The token endpoint mandates codeVerifier as a required parameter (route.ts:L36) and gates token issuance on verifyCodeChallenge returning true (route.ts:L116-121). Edge cases (null method, null challenge) both produce false, not bypass.
